transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because I need some help. After I eat too much, I keep going into the bathroom and making myself throw up. I just do it so I won't gain weight, but... it's gotten to the point where I'm honestly scared I can't stop doing it.
How often do you eat too much in one sitting?

It happens pretty much every night. Usually, it's at night after everyone’s gone quiet in the house. I’ll just stand in the kitchen and eat leftovers, cereal, chips, ice cream... really whatever’s there. I just keep going, way past a normal meal, until half the pantry looks picked over.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?

Well, for at least the past three months, there’s hardly been a week where I didn’t have one of those late-night eating episodes and then go make myself throw up right afterward. Some weeks it happens several times... especially when I’m stuck at home more because of my back.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yes, I am. I mean, honestly, even seeing a single pound up on the bathroom scale makes me panic. It just makes me feel like all this time I've been laid up with my back is turning me soft. As soon as I see the number go up, I start planning how to undo it... usually before I can even think straight about anything else.
Have you ever had one of those late-night eating episodes where you didn't make yourself throw up afterward?
No, not really. If I have one of those big eating episodes, I always make myself throw up. I can't just leave it sitting there, I have to get rid of it.
Have you ever had one of those big eating episodes during the day?
No, not really. It's pretty much always at night. During the day... I don't know, I just don't really have the urge to do it then. It's usually late in the evening when all of that happens.
Do you think your weight or body shape is a problem even when others tell you that you look fine?

Yeah, I do. It doesn't really matter what anyone else says. If my work pants start feeling tight, or if I just catch a glimpse of my belly in the mirror... I don't know, I just feel like I'm failing at everything. It makes me feel like I'm not that same strong woman who used to be able to handle heavy transmissions and just keep up with the guys in the shop. It really bothers me.
During those late-night eating episodes, do you feel like you're able to stop eating if you want to?

No, I really don't. Once I start on those nights, it's like... my hands just keep grabbing food. Even while I'm sitting there telling myself, 'Lucy, knock it off,' I just keep going. I don't feel like I'm back in charge until it's already done.
Have you ever had a late-night eating episode where you felt like you lost control, but you didn't make yourself throw up afterward?
No, I haven't. I mean, if I have one of those nights where I just can't stop eating, I always make myself throw up afterwards. I've never just... let it sit there. I always have to get rid of it.
Have you ever had an episode of eating too much where you felt like you lost control, but you didn't make yourself throw up afterward?
I think we just talked about this, but no, I haven't. Like I said, if I lose control and eat like that, I always make myself throw up. I never just leave it.
Have you ever used laxatives or diuretics to try to get rid of the calories after one of those big eating episodes?
No, I haven't done that. I don't use laxatives or water pills or anything like that. It's just the throwing up for me.
Have you ever had a period of time, even just a few days, where you didn't make yourself throw up after one of those late-night eating episodes?

No, honestly, I haven't. It's pretty much exactly like I was saying a minute ago... if I eat like that, I throw up. Every single time. There's never been a stretch of days, or even just one night, where I just let it go. If the eating happens, I always have to do it.
Have you ever had an episode of eating too much where you felt like you lost control, but you didn't make yourself throw up afterward, even if it was just once?
I know you're just trying to be thorough, but like I said, no. Never. If I lose control and eat like that, I always make myself throw up. There hasn't been a single time where I didn't.
Have you ever exercised excessively to try to get rid of the calories after one of those big eating episodes?

No, I don't really do that either. I mean, I'm on my feet a lot at work, moving around the shop, but I don't go to the gym or run for hours or anything to try and work off the food. Like I said, it's really just the throwing up that I do.
Have you ever fasted for a day or more after one of those big eating episodes?

No, I don't really do that. I mean, I eat normally during the day, mostly. I don't go a whole day without eating just because of what happened the night before. I just... I stick to my regular meals. It's really just the throwing up that I rely on.
Have you ever used any other methods to try to get rid of calories after eating, besides making yourself throw up?
No, nothing else. I don't take pills or anything like that. Just the throwing up.
Have you ever had a period where you binged on food but didn't make yourself throw up more than once?

No, not really. I mean, if I have one of those big eating episodes, I pretty much always make myself throw up afterwards. I don't think there's ever been a time where I just kept it down. It's just... it's what I do every time.
Have you ever used any methods besides throwing up to try to undo the effects of one of those big eating episodes?
No, like I said, it's just the throwing up. I don't use laxatives or water pills or run on the treadmill for hours or anything. I just... I throw it up, and that's it.
Have you ever had a period where you binged on food more than once without making yourself throw up afterwards?
No, I... I think you already asked me that. Like I said, if I eat like that, I throw it up. I don't really have times where I just let it sit there. It always ends the same way.
